criteria.reason: class-maintenance-banner-settings-page.php add_page() calls add_options_page() with 'manage_options' and a render callback.
class-maintenance-banner-options.php register() calls register_setting() for maintenance_banner_options with 'type' => 'object', 'sanitize_callback' => sanitize and 'default' => self::defaults().

In class-maintenance-banner-options.php, show_in_rest['schema'] => self::schema() defines properties for enabled, message, background_color, start_datetime, end_datetime and hidden_roles, and sets additionalProperties false.

class-maintenance-banner-settings-page.php add_fields() uses add_settings_section/add_settings_field, and render_page() uses a form posting to options.php with settings_fields() and do_settings_sections().

Maintenance_Banner_Options::sanitize() uses rest_sanitize_boolean for enabled, wp_kses with allowed_html(), sanitize_hex_color, and sanitize_datetime() with createFromFormat round-trip checks, then intersects roles with array_keys(wp_roles()->get_names()).
In sanitize(), when $end <= $start, report_error() calls add_settings_error('end_before_start') and the previous start/end values are kept.
The field callbacks in class-maintenance-banner-settings-page.php use esc_attr, esc_textarea, esc_html and checked() throughout.
src/index.js calls registerPlugin(), and src/sidebar.js renders PluginSidebar (plus PluginSidebarMoreMenuItem) from @wordpress/editor.
SidebarContent in src/sidebar.js uses useEntityRecord('root','site') edit/editedRecord and saves with saveEditedEntityRecord('root','site', undefined, { throwOnError: true }).
MaintenanceBannerSidebar gates rendering on useSelect(select(coreStore).canUser('update', { kind: 'root', name: 'site' })), and the PHP enqueue also checks current_user_can('manage_options').

class-maintenance-banner-frontend.php hooks wp_body_open, and should_display() checks enabled, compares current_datetime() against start/end in wp_timezone(), and checks the user's roles against hidden_roles.
render() prints the message through wp_kses() with allowed_html() and passes the colour through sanitize_hex_color then esc_attr in the style attribute.
uninstall.php checks WP_UNINSTALL_PLUGIN and calls delete_option('maintenance_banner_options'), including on every site in a multisite network.

Every API used exists, including useEntityRecord hasEdits/edit, isSavingEntityRecord, throwOnError, Button accessibleWhenDisabled, PluginSidebarMoreMenuItem from @wordpress/editor, current_datetime, wp_timezone_string and translate_user_role.
